entries.subject: Two identical machine screws and two matching spur gears: two families of interchangeable standardized components.
entries.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: transparent TECHNOLOGY invention icon for Victoria 3, not a building icon or a flat production-method pictogram.
Input images: Image 1 is the existing icon to edit; preserve its hand-painted volumetric style, viewpoint, material palette and lighting.
Background: genuine transparent alpha around the object and through exterior openings. Preserve transparency, no black or checkerboard painted background, floor, ground shadow, building scene, frame, medallion or text.
Natural warm-neutral material colors, no blue/teal cast, no sepia overlay. Compact silhouette, whole subject intact, generous transparent margins, square canvas at least 1024 pixels; readable at 48/64 pixels.
Primary request: diversify the INTERCHANGEABLE PARTS concept with toothed gear wheels. Replace the existing three-screw-and-gauge group with a compact group of TWO identical slotted machine screws and TWO identical spur gear wheels. Keep the screws' existing natural iron finish, proportions and restrained painted texture. Remove the small fork gauge to keep the group readable.
The two matching iron spur gears have exactly the same diameter, thickness, central circular bore, simple spoke pattern and evenly spaced straight peripheral teeth. Show broad readable teeth, not a tiny toothed ring or decorative clock mechanism. Place the two matching gears near the two parallel screws, slight overlap permitted but both toothed outlines and central bores remain visible. All parts share coherent perspective, upper-left light and warm-neutral steel finish.
The screws match each other, the gears match each other: two families of standardized replaceable parts, NOT four unrelated shapes. No assembled machine, extra washers or nuts, measuring scales, box, workshop or random gear train. This is a conceptual technology illustration, not a certified reconstruction of a named museum object.
